name: @otter/relay
description: relay.mail.otterware.app: Otter account sign-in, linked accounts, agent chats and realtime Gmail notifications.

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev.ts --local-upstream localhost:8787 --var IDENTITY_MODE:legacy --var BETTER_AUTH_URL:http://localhost:8787 --var APP_ORIGIN:http://localhost:5833 --var COOKIE_DOMAIN: --var TUNNEL_ALLOW_PRIVATE:true
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist && sentry-cli sourcemaps inject dist
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply otter-mail-relay --remote && wrangler deploy dist/worker.js --no-bundle
